global_events: Twenty-one current official Auction House August 2026 records were decided; eighteen selected and three fail-closed.
Auction House UK, Savills, Allsop and SDL were checked; current unused evidence retained in this batch came from Auction House UK.
Eighteen current official source records were retained, including two full-direct upgrades and sixteen current search-result snapshots.
All retained candidates have future 11–25 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.
Twenty-one representative exact-address repository searches returned zero indexed hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
37 Tan Yr Allt was excluded because the current list and description exposed conflicting August and July event states.
Elm Bank was excluded because the current official list did not expose a guide price.
140 Popple Street was excluded because current property, tenure and occupational detail was insufficient.
Sixteen selected records were constrained to the current official search-result snapshot and were not expanded with stale earlier-event evidence.
87 Ewers Road and 29A Cromwell Road were verified on current full-detail official pages.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher tenancy, rent and gross-income wording was not independently underwritten.
Title, lease, service charges, shared-freehold structure and building obligations require legal-pack review.
Commercial and residential configuration, lawful use and occupational structure at Gleneagles Road were not independently verified.
Apartment-building and high-rise matters require legal, building-safety and professional review.
Configuration, extension status, measurements, services, contents and condition require professional inspection.
Publisher vacancy or tenancy statements remain subject to legal-pack confirmation.
Development, extension, alternative-use and lawful-use outcomes were not inferred.
Buyer premiums, administration charges and legal-pack disbursements were not included in guide prices.
Repository search indexing may be incomplete; no exhaustive uniqueness claim was made.
No second runner, owner or task was created; continuation key was preserved.
Research was divided across four bounded groups while GitHub writes remained serial.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Public-host, parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence was created.
